document.abstract: During 1969 advances in motion-picture and television engineering kept pace with the historic events that closed one of the most awesome decades in history. Without the tremendous strides in photo-instrumentation, television and specially designed cameras, the Moon- Walk could not have taken place as it did and certainly it could not have been vicariously participated in by the millions of viewers who watched “live” the slow descent from the space capsule and the first stumbling steps of man on tnily alien soil.
